name: Into the Expanse
description: Beyond the eastern deep perimeter lies a vast ruined zone — the Outer Expanse, abandoned infrastructure from before the Collapse. Whatever happened here, it happened fast. Push through to find out what remains.

find_relay_terminal.label: Find the Relay Terminal
find_relay_terminal.description: Somewhere in the ruins is a gutted relay terminal from the old network. It may still hold data.

completionActions.text: The terminal is stripped — but someone scratched Array-band coordinates into the casing. Left deliberately.

reach_void_flats.label: Reach the Void Flats
reach_void_flats.description: Push east through the Outer Expanse to its far edge. The passage beyond leads to the Void Flats — the last frontier before the deep Nightside.

completionActions.text: Quest complete: Into the Expanse. The Void Flats stretch in every direction — this is beyond any mapped territory. What comes next is uncharted.
